'''Dorrian Vodani''' was a [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew a [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunter]] while escaping [[Arda Base]] during the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]]. He was the [[Squadron Leader/Legends|commander]] of [[Rust Squadron]].<ref name="OAA1" />

==Personality and traits==
Dorrian Vodani is a quiet and introspective, and likes to read old texts written by [[corrimias]], a [[Philosopher/Legends|Philosopher]] who Dorrian honored and lived by his teachings. unfortunately, his quiet and antisocial personality makes him a big suspect of being a traitor to the [[Ardan resistance]]. Eventually he is ruled out of being a traitor because he shares his philosophies of peace and equality with his peers.<ref name="OAA1" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' {{1st}}
